messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: P1 - spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate. Error-rate > 8% over 2m. Paging: maria (oncall). Logs show upstream provider errors. Link: https://ops.example.com/incidents/1790004321

maria (oncall): acked. I see the spike, throttling and 504s from gateway. Repro query: `ts-query error: service=api route=/v1/generate status>=500`

maria (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback-model routing (route ~5% traffic to small fallback) 2) bump timeout at edge from 8s -> 12s 3) suppress noisy alert for 15m while we validate. Doing 1 now.

devon: on it, running traffic split - applying rollout: `redwoodctl route set --service api --route /v1/generate --variant fallback-v1 --weight 5`

devon: rollout applied, traffic verify: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq .model` -> responses showing fallback-v1 for ~5% requests

maria (oncall): observed 5xx rate dropping from 8.6% -> 3.2% after split and timeout bump. Some upstream gateway 502s still present but lower volume. Customer impact: a handful of sessions saw transient failures, CS reported 3 customers affected (IDs in incident doc).

samir: the upstream provider (edge-ml-1) reported degraded pods. Reached out to provider Slack, they acknowledged an internal autoscaler bug. ETA unknown.

tian: +1 for changing alerting logic post-incident. Current 5xx alert is too noisy: fires on short spikes. Proposal: change rule to use a 5m rolling window, require >2% absolute and >=50 errors in window, and split 502/504 from 5xx rate to identify upstream vs app errors. Also add a new dashboard panel for upstream error origin.

ashleigh: can you paste a suggested Prometheus rule? I can PR it.

maria (oncall): suggested rule (quick draft):
```
- alert: HighAPI5xxRate
  expr: sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) > 0.02
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High 5xx rate on /v1/generate (>2% over 5m and >50 errors)"
    runbook: "https://ops.example.com/runbooks/high-5xx"
```
Then add an additional condition to require `sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",code=~"5.."}[5m])) > 50` in the expr.

devon: +1. Also split alerts: `GatewayTimeouts` for 504s and `Upstream502s` for 502 with label origin=upstream. That helped us triage faster this time.

maria (oncall): created short-term alert suppression window for current noisy alert: `alerts.suppress(1790004321, 15m)` so we don't get paged repeatedly while mitigating. Documented suppression in incident log.

samir: ops update from provider: autoscaler fix rolled to edge-ml-1, pod restarts incoming. We'll watch error rate for next 10m.

maria (oncall): handing off to tian for next hour coverage while I join customer call. Key actions for follow-up:
- Add Prometheus rule PR (ashleigh)
- New Grafana panels: 5xx rate by upstream, 504 timeouts trend, request volume baseline (tian)
- Update runbook section for "suppress alerts during active mitigation" (maria)
- Postmortem draft and customer-impact summary (maria + devon)

tian: ack takeover. I'll create the Grafana panel templates and the alert PR if ashleigh is busy. Putting a card: https://boards.example.com/card/INC-1790004321

ashleigh: I'll own the Prometheus PR. Will include the >50 errors guard and separate 502/504 alerts and note in the changelog. ETA 2h.

devon: monitoring note: we need to track absolute error counts as well as rate. Low-traffic routes can spike rate easily. Suggest adding `min(error_count, 50)` style guard as suggested.

tian: post-incident tuning checklist I'll follow: 1) change alert expr to 5m window + min errors 2) move severity to page only when for: 5m sustained 3) create dashboard with origin breakdown and region split 4) add synthetic canary to /v1/health to catch upstream slowness earlier

maria (oncall): thanks team. Closing paging now as error rate stable at ~0.9% and provider confirms healthy. I'll file postmortem and tag CS for customer notifications. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Incident 1790004321 status: mitigated. Postmortem invited: https://ops.example.com/postmortems/1790004321

tian: putting follow-up tasks into backlog and I will roll the alert rule PR after review. Assigning to ashleigh for rule, tian for dashboard, devon for traffic split runbook updates.

ashleigh: PR opened: https://git.example.com/infra/alerts/pulls/432. Includes test query and alert suppression bake-in steps.

maria (oncall): handoff complete, thanks all. Leaving thread for postmortem comments. :bow:
